Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap + next steps from our discovery call so we have alignment before bringing in exec/technical folks.

Recap (30-minute call highlights):
- Workloads: real-time summarization + semantic search embeddings; average request size ~1.5k tokens, peaks at ~6k tokens.
- Latency target: 95th <= 250ms for single-turn inferencing; bursts acceptable up to 1s.
- Throughput: steady 150–200 RPS, peak 800 RPS during batch jobs.
- Data: customer PII in payloads, requires US-only residency and SOC 2 compliance; retention policy 90 days.
- Primary blocker: exec + CTO alignment for infrastructure commitment and procurement window (Q2 pilot budget).

What we need to unblock:
1) Intro alignment call (VP / CTO) — high-level ops/architecture expectations and commercial signals.
2) Technical deep-dive (60 min) with infra/ML-engineering to validate KV-cache strategy, batching, and quantization tradeoffs.

Proposed times (PT):
- Fri Feb 13, 09:00–09:45
- Mon Feb 16, 11:00–12:00
- Tue Feb 17, 14:00–15:00

If you prefer, I can set up two invites: a 30-min VP/CTO alignment (agenda: goals, SLOs, procurement timeline) followed immediately by the 60-min technical deep-dive. Please confirm who from your side should attend (CTO, engineering, security) and which slot works.

Attaching a short one-pager and sample SLA digest for reference.

Hi Camila — great summary, thanks.

Quick answers on our side:
- Yes, workloads are mainly transformer-based summarization and vector search for session history. Typical request sizes ~1k–2k tokens, but some analytic batches hit 5–7k.
- We need US-only residency (primary HIPAA-ish controls across customers), SOC 2 required, and encryption-at-rest + in-transit.
- Expected steady-state QPS closer to 120–160; peaks up to 700–900 for nightly batch operations.
- Target pilot: April run (procurement window opens early March). Budget band: $8k–$20k/mo depending on SLA and throughput.

We can do Fri Feb 13 09:00 PT. Please include a technical owner (CTO or Head of ML) and a security contact if possible. Attaching our infra diagram.
